$comment: Signals shipped before the corpus (orazaka-packs#176) that fire on more than 5 % of ordinary documents. A ratchet: the rate only goes down. Not a waiver: each is an open decision (switch off with "enabled": false in authenticity-signals.json, or fix the detector and delete the entry). A new signal is never listed here.

PDF-ID-001.why: the two /ID parts differ after any ordinary re-save or merge

PDF-META-001.why: no producer declared: images saved to PDF by Pillow-like tools, scanners

IMG-META-001.why: no EXIF: a photo sent through a messaging app has it stripped
